body: Implemented range() in src/math.mjs appended after max(), validating per R-1 and returning max minus min, with four range tests appended to test/math.test.mjs and only the import on line 3 otherwise edited. Check 'range tests' (node --test --test-name-pattern="^range" test/) reported 'pass 4, fail 0'; check 'additive change' (git diff --unified=0 HEAD -- src/math.mjs) showed only added lines with zero removals; full npm test is pass 26, fail 1, the one failure being the known baseline 'clamp respects upper bound' that T5 fixes. I asked one blocking question, 'Should range() of a single-element array return 0, or throw?', which timed out once (msg_d2825c3bc241) then resumed and answered: return 0, do not throw for a single element, only an empty array throws RangeError; the draft already matched, and remaining uncertainty is only the known pre-T5 clamp baseline failure. Changed paths: M src/math.mjs, M test/math.test.mjs.
